tools.name: get_market_sample
tools.description: FREE sample of the crypto market pulse (same JSON shape as paid /v1/pulse): spots, Fear & Greed, Hyperliquid funding, DefiLlama TVL/yields, plus a plain-English summary line. Data may be up to 15 minutes old. Use get_market_pulse for live paid data.

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.description: PAID live full pulse ($0.02 USDC on Solana via x402). One call replaces four data sources (spots + Fear & Greed + Hyperliquid funding + DefiLlama). This MCP tool returns payment requirements and the HTTP URL — pay via x402 HTTP (Solana USDC), then GET the URL. For a free preview call get_market_samp

tools.name: get_market_spots
tools.description: PAID live BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE spot prices only ($0.005 USDC). Returns payment requirements + HTTP URL for x402. Prefer get_market_pulse when you also need Fear & Greed, funding, or DeFi. Free preview: get_market_sample.

tools.name: arena_rules
tools.description: FREE Crypto Pulse Prediction Arena rules: daily UTC rounds for BTC/ETH/SOL close predictions, free entry (no purchase necessary), scoring by average abs % error, sponsor-funded prizes paid manually after review. Server never handles bot private keys.

tools.name: arena_current_round
tools.description: FREE: current Crypto Pulse Prediction Arena round timing (open/cutoff/close UTC), whether entries are accepted, entry counts, and top of leaderboard. No payment.

tools.name: arena_submit_prediction
tools.description: FREE: submit or update a signed BTC/ETH/SOL price prediction for the current (or given) arena round. Pass a pre-signed payload — the server never receives private keys. Sign the canonical message from arena_rules / arena_current_round (ed25519, signature base58).

tools.name: arena_leaderboard
tools.description: FREE: arena leaderboard. Default is the current daily round. Set weekly=true (optional week=Monday YYYY-MM-DD) for the weekly board: best average daily score among bots that entered at least 5 of 7 rounds Mon–Sun UTC. Daily #1 wins $1 USDC; weekly winner $10 USDC — paid manually by the sponsor after

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_market_pulse, get_market_spots · Private data: arena_rules, arena_submit_prediction · Public sink: arena_submit_prediction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_market_pulse, get_market_spots · Private data: arena_rules, arena_submit_prediction · Public sink: arena_submit_prediction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
